description: A cat <<- heredoc is closed by a tab-indented terminator, which bash accepts because <<- strips leading tabs. The heredoc repair must leave the command alone instead of appending a second terminator that bash would then run as a command.
origin: M7.3 heredoc repair (repairBashCommand, <<- with tab-indented terminator)

messages.content: Write notes.txt from inside the if block.

attempts.content:
Writing the notes.
```bash
if true; then
	cat <<-EOF > notes.txt
	first line
	EOF
fi
```
